pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: The book stays flat. March funding futures at 4.545 have already repriced 61 basis points above the 3.93 cash fixing, September at 4.710 is only a little beyond that front contract, and euro-sterling at 0.8331 has no catalyst that would out-earn cash charged on risk capital. Preservation means declining new risk whose expected mark change does not clear that funding cost with room.
